headline: Book Review: ‘Anti-Zionism,’ by Benjamin Moser
context: In a new book, the prizewinning biographer Benjamin Moser charts a tradition of Jewish opposition to Zionism and recounts his belated conversion to that view.

sources.name: The New York Times
